name: Ōchi (Kagawa, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ōchi town emblem in white: a ring of three segments enclosing a three-armed device.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōchi in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1958.

features.role: Ōchi town emblem — a ring of three segments enclosing a three-armed device
